traceability.notes: Based on the inspected code, tests, configuration, and documentation, story docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md is fully implemented. The plugin is structured as a standard ESLint plugin module in TypeScript, with a dynamic rule registry and flat-config compatible recommended/strict presets. Tests specifically tagged to this story (plugin-setup, plugin-default-export-and-configs, plugin-setup-error, cli-error-handling, and integration/cli-integration) verify that the plugin exports the expected shape, registers rules, integrates correctly with ESLint v9 flat config, and handles rule loading errors gracefully, including CLI behavior. package.json, tsconfig.json, and the presence of src/rules/* demonstrate a publishable npm package and TypeScript-based implementation. README.md and docs/eslint-plugin-development-guide.md together provide clear installation, configuration, and development guidance. A recent CI run on main executed the full verification pipeline (including build, lint, type-check, and Jest tests) successfully, providing additional evidence that the foundational ESLint plugin setup behaves as required. All acceptance criteria and listed requirements for this story are therefore satisfied.
